description: List backups for a specific instance (by id or exact name), sorted newest first. Returns id, name, date, size in bytes, type (auto/manual/etc.), storage backend, and whether it is locked (locked backups are never deleted automatically when the quota fills). Also includes per-instance backup quota usage.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

limit.description: Maximum number of backups to return (1-100). Defaults to 25.

name: list_backups
title: List Backups
